card.name: Time or place word right after a noun
card.fires_on: A short time or direction word such as post, peri, early, east or north placed right after a noun phrase. It often comes before a word like operatively, hysterectomy, "of" or "during".

modes.label: Timing prefix after a noun
modes.description: A word like post, peri or early follows a condition or verb and marks timing relative to surgery or treatment.
modes.example: is 5,000 units subcutaneously the evening before surgery, then once daily<< post>>operatively.

modes.label: Direction after a place
modes.description: A compass word such as east or north follows a named place and precedes "of".
modes.example: the cupola remained the largest construction of its kind<< north>> of the Alps.

card.writes: It favors adverb endings such as -ally, -antly and -atively, which would complete words like operatively.
card.plain: It fires on a small timing or direction word after a noun, where an adverb-like word is likely to follow.
